raw_segments.text: Why, I said, you join physicians and judges.
Now the most skillful physicians are those who, from their youth upwards, have combined
with the knowledge of their art the greatest experience of disease.
They had better not be robust in health, and should have had all manner of diseases in
For the body, as I conceive, is not the instrument with which they cure the body.
In that case we could not allow them ever to be or to have been sickly, but they cure
the body with the mind, and the mind which has become and is sick can cure nothing.
